|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Fizz}} {{tip|dash|dashes}} through the target enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}}, {{as|physical damage}}, and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fizz''' {{tip|dashes}} a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy. If they are in range upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} plus {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
|description2 = ''{{ai|Seastone Trident|Fizz}} and {{ai|Chum the Waters|Fizz}} can be cast during the dash.''

W.name: Seastone Trident
W.title: Template:Data Fizz/Seastone Trident
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Seastone Trident|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Fizz
|skill        = W
|icon         = false
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Fizz}} basic attacks bleed his enemies, continually dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fizz''' empowers his next basic attack to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, and has an additional effect based on fatality.
* If this attack kills the target, the cooldown is {{sti|ah|reduced}} and the {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} is refunded.
* If this attack does not kill the target, '''Fizz's''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} for a few seconds.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Fizz's''' basic attacks rend enemies {{tip|on-hit}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.
|leveling     = {{st|Total Passive Magic Damage|{{ap|30 to 90}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}|Passive Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|30/6 to 90/6|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25/6|round=2}}% AP)}}}}
|icon2        = Seastone Trident.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fizz''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
|leveling2    = {{st|Active Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 150}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}}}
|description3 = If ''Seastone Trident'' kills its target, the {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced to 1 second and the {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} is refunded. Otherwise, if the target is not killed, '''Fizz's''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} for the next 5 seconds. 
|leveling3    = {{st|Active On-Hit Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}}}
|description4 = ''Seastone Trident's'' active damage can be applied against {{tip|structures}} at 50% effectiveness. Active and on-hit damage deal an additional {{as|90 '''bonus''' magic damage}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
|description5 = ''Seastone Trident {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Fizz's''' basic attack timer.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|7 to 3}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = {{ap|30 to 70}}
|costtype     = Mana
|cast time = none
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = special
|occurrence   = On-hit
|parry        = Special
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* Applies {{tip|spell damage}} on the empowered attack, {{tip|persistent damage}} additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}} on the damage over time effect, and {{tip|proc damage}} on the bonus damage on-hit.
* ''Seastone Trident's '' interactions with {{tip|dodge|dodging}}, {{tip|block|blocking}}, and {{tip|blind|blinding}} effects.
** The passive bonus damage gets negated by {{tip|dodge|dodging}} or {{tip|block|blocking}} the attack, or if '''Fizz''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
** The active:
*** If the attacked enemy is {{tip|dodge|dodging}} or if '''Fizz''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}, the empowered attack won't deal any damage, but the empowered attack won't be consumed.
*** If the attacked enemy is {{tip|block|blocking}}, the empowered attack won't deal any damage despite being consumed. But the attack will apply the passive bonus damage of ''Seastone Trident''.
* The empowered attack will trigger against {{tip|structures}}.
}}

E.name: Playful
E.title: Template:Data Fizz/Playful
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Playful|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Fizz
|skill        = E
|icon         = Playful.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Fizz}} {{tip|dash|vaults}} in the target direction and balances onto his spear, becoming {{tip|untargetable}}. From this position, Fizz can either slam the ground or choose to jump again with ''{{ai|Trickster|Fizz}}''.
|blurb2       = Slamming the ground deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} nearby enemies.
|post-blurb   = Fizz/Trickster
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fizz''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location while becoming {{tip|untargetable}}, balancing on his trident for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, during which he can cast ''{{ai|Trickster|Fizz}}'' after {{fd|0.15}} seconds into the duration.
|description2 = He then begins to hop off of his trident over {{fd|0.5}} seconds, during which he gains {{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, and afterwards becoming targetable and landing to create a splash that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 280}} {{as|(+ 95% AP)}}}}{{st|Slow|{{ap|40 to 60}}%}}
|description3 = ''While hopping off of the trident, '''Fizz''' may input movement commands to direct his landing.''
|target range = {{tt|25 - 400|Minimum and maximum dash distance}}
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 375
|cast time    = none
|cooldown     = {{ap|16 to 8}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = {{ap|75 to 95}}
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = special
|outofrange   = cast at max
|notes        = 
{{always quickcast}}
*''Playful'' counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
**Detonating the ability early for {{ai|Trickster|Fizz}} does not.
* The distance covered during ''Playful's'' directed splash is equal to half of '''Fizz's''' movement speed.
* ''Playful'' cannot be used for approximately {{fd|0.5}} seconds after using {{ai|Urchin Strike|Fizz}}.
* {{si|Flash}} can be used while hopping off the trident, but not while balanced on it.
* '''Fizz''' can receive aggro while hopping off the trident, but not while balanced on it
{{safesubst:unexpected|desc=
* If the first dash is interrupted, '''Fizz''' initiates the hop immediately, and if the second one is, the splash will not occur.
** In either cases, '''Fizz''' loses the untargetability. [https://youtu.be/Zjtcee-OvUQ] {{bug|2}}|affectedEffects=Fizz E|estimatedPatchOrigin=V1.0.0.129|<!--added automatically-->wikiUploadTimestamp=1776194123|<!--added automatically-->pagename=Template:Data Fizz/Playful
}}
* If ''Playful'' is cast while under the effect of a move block, '''Fizz''' will not become untargetable and will initiate the hop instantly.{{bug}}
** If {{ai|Trickster|Fizz}} is cast, the splash will not occur.{{bug}}
* If '''Fizz''' casts ''Playful'' on top of himself after {{tip|blink|blinking}} and not moving from the blinked-to spot, the minimum dash distance of 25 units will not apply (casts at 0 range).{{bug}}
* If '''Fizz''' enters {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}} during either ''Playful'' or {{ai|Trickster|Fizz}}, the splash occurs after the stasis ends.
}}
